transformation_test.error_units: Euclidean image distance over 784 coverage values; no clipping before scoring

model_definitions.best_scalar_plus_constant_offset: a * normal_curve(t) + b; one scalar and one fixed 784-vector, fitted using target training samples
model_definitions.interpolate_adjacent_width_curves: weighted mean of known curves bracketing target width at 0.1-width spacing

transformation_test.limits: The reusable increment is a lean-dependent 784-vector curve, not one fixed offset or one angle. Neighbor interpolation requires two nearby known curves. Center and height remain fixed.

angle_graph_rules.note: Fits predict a scalar angle-to-reference graph only. They do not specify a 784D direction or reconstruct images. Target training samples calibrate each pair.
